/* Fragment fixture (PF-3 gate): one branch slice of a NAV-style entry
 * function, holding its own decls, one embedded cursor, and FML calls. */
char c_flag;
long li_demo_comp;
varchar sql_nav_date[21];
varchar sql_nav_nav[21];

if(c_flag == 'H')
{
    if(Fget32(Ibuffer,FML_COMP_CD,0,(char*)&li_demo_comp,0) == -1)
    {
        tpreturn(TPFAIL,0L,0L,0L,0);
    }

    EXEC SQL
    DECLARE cur_demo CURSOR FOR
        SELECT NAV_DATE, NAV_VALUE
        FROM DEMO_PRICE_HIST
        WHERE COMP_CD = :li_demo_comp
        ORDER BY NAV_DATE DESC;

    EXEC SQL OPEN cur_demo;
    EXEC SQL FETCH cur_demo INTO :sql_nav_date, :sql_nav_nav;
    EXEC SQL CLOSE cur_demo;

    Fadd32(Obuffer,FML_NAV_DATE,(char*)sql_nav_date.arr,0);
    Fadd32(Obuffer,FML_NAV_VALUE,(char*)sql_nav_nav.arr,0);
}
else
{
    Fadd32(Obuffer,FML_ERR_MSG,"bad flag",0);
}
